answer: With a Registered domain bound by one-time code delivery with a ninety-day rotation cooldown, the account is only as strong as its binding: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The design treats each channel as a vine: small alone, decisive in aggregate. A plume alone is noise; a trellis of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
